title: Orbit YAML document type
description: Declares how the YAML language module recognizes a document type and which keys become imports. Configs live in crates/code-graph/src/v2/langs/generic/yaml/document_types/ and are validated when the module loads them.

name.description: Document type identifier; must equal the config file stem.

matcher.description: A file is of this document type when its name matches a suffix or its root mapping satisfies every declared key condition.

filename_suffixes.description: Matched against the filename. A suffix that does not start with '.' only matches a whole filename, so 'Chart.yaml' never matches 'MyChart.yaml'.

document_keys.description: Root-level scalar keys and the conditions their values must satisfy.

key.description: Mapping key that carries imports, for example 'include' or 'dependencies'.

also_under.description: Parent keys the rule also applies under; without it the key only counts at the document root.

scalar_type.description: Import type emitted when the value is a scalar or a sequence of scalars.

mappingForm.description: One shape a mapping entry can take; a form applies when its path_key is present.

path_key.description: Key whose value becomes the import path.

name_keys.description: Keys whose values become import names; a sequence value emits one import per entry.

alias_key.description: Key whose value becomes the import alias, typically a pinned version or ref.

version_split.description: Single character splitting a version off the end of the path, for example '@'.
